sourceSentences.text: As her hand fell on the latch of the kitchen door, she noticed one wax-sealed pot that had fallen on its side and rolled into a corner.
She stooped down to retrieve it.
It was leaking a little.
She licked her sticky finger.
Cherry preserves.
She smiled ruefully, then tucked it into the crook of her arm.
She would take this last bit of sweetness with her.
‘Lady Companion?’
Serilla lifted her eyes from the map she was perusing.
The serving boy at the door of the study looked deferentially at his feet.
‘Yes?’ she acknowledged him.
‘There is a woman to see you.’
‘I’m busy.
She will have to come back at a better time.’
She was mildly annoyed with him.
He should have known she did not want any other visitors today.
It was late, and she had spent all the afternoon in a stuffy room full of Traders, trying to make them see sense.
They quibbled over the most self-evident things.
Some were still insisting that there must be a vote of the Council before they would recognize her authority over them.
Trader Larfa had quite rudely suggested that Bingtown should settle Bingtown matters, with no advice from Jamaillia.
It was most frustrating.
She had shown them the authorization that she had extorted from the Satrap.
She had written it herself, and knew it to be unchallengeable.
Why would they not admit that she held the authority of the Satrap, and that Bingtown was subject to the Satrap’s authority?
She consulted the Bingtown chart once more.
So far, the Traders had been able to keep their harbour open, but it was at the expense of all trade.
The town could not long survive those circumstances.
The Chalcedeans knew that very well.
They did not have to rush in and control Bingtown immediately.
Trade was the lifeblood of Bingtown and the Chalcedeans were slowly but surely strangling it.
The stubborn Traders were the ones who refused to see the obvious.
Bingtown was a single settlement on a hostile coast.
It had never been able to feed itself.
How could it stand up to the onslaught of a warlike country like Chalced?
She had asked that of the Council leaders.
They replied that they had done it before and would do it again.
But those other times, the might of Jamaillia backed them.
And they had not had to contend with New Traders in their midst who might welcome a Chalcedean invasion.
Many New Traders had close ties with Chalced, for that was the major market for the slaves they funnelled through Bingtown.
She considered again the bird-message Roed Caern had intercepted and brought to her.
It had promised a Jamaillian fleet would soon set out to take revenge on the corrupt and rebellious Old Traders for the murder of the Satrap.
Just to think of it made Serilla cold.
The message had arrived too soon.
No bird could fly that fast.
To her, it meant that the conspiracy was widespread, extending to the nobility of Jamaillia City itself.
Whoever had sent the bird to Jamaillia had expected that the Satrap would be murdered and that evidence would point to the Old Traders.
The swiftness of the reply indicated that those who responded had been awaiting the message.
The only question was how extensive the conspiracy was.
Even if she could root out the source of it, she did not know if she could destroy it.
If only Roed Caern and his men had not been so hasty the night that they seized the Satrap.
If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them.
They might have revealed who of the Jamaillian nobility were involved in this.
But Restart was dead and the Vestrits missing.
She’d get no answers there.
She pushed the chart to one side and replaced it with an elegant map of Bingtown.
The finely-inked and illustrated work was one of the wonders she’d discovered in Restart’s library.
In addition to the original grants of all the Old Traders, with each holding inked in the family’s colour, Davad had penned in the main claims of the New Traders.
She studied it, wondering if it might offer some clue to his allies.
She frowned over it, then lifted her pen, dipped it, and made a note to herself.
She liked the location of Barberry Hill.
It would be a convenient summer home for her, once all this strife was settled.
It had been a New Trader holding; likely the Bingtown Traders would be glad to cede it to her.
Or as the Satrap’s representative, she could simply take it.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: The stubborn Traders were the ones who refused to see the obvious. Bingtown was a single settlement on a hostile coast. It had never been able to feed itself. How could it stand up to the onslaught of a warlike country like Chalced? She had asked that of the Council leaders. They replied that they had done it before and would do it again. But those other times, the might of Jamaillia backed them. And they had not had to contend with New Traders in their midst who might welcome a Chalcedean invasion. Many New Traders had close ties with Chalced, for that was the major market for the slaves they funnelled through Bingtown.
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Упрямые торговцы отказывались видеть очевидное. Бингтаун был одиноким поселением на враждебном побережье. Он никогда не мог прокормить себя сам. Как мог он выстоять против натиска такой воинственной страны, как Калсид? Она задала этот вопрос главам Совета. Они ответили, что уже делали это прежде и сделают снова. Но в те времена за ними стояла мощь Джамелии. И им не приходилось иметь дело с Новыми торговцами среди них, которые могли бы приветствовать калсидийское вторжение. Многие Новые торговцы были тесно связаны с Калсидом, ведь именно там находился главный рынок для рабов, которых они переправляли через Бингтаун.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: She considered again the bird-message Roed Caern had intercepted and brought to her. It had promised a Jamaillian fleet would soon set out to take revenge on the corrupt and rebellious Old Traders for the murder of the Satrap. Just to think of it made Serilla cold. The message had arrived too soon. No bird could fly that fast. To her, it meant that the conspiracy was widespread, extending to the nobility of Jamaillia City itself. Whoever had sent the bird to Jamaillia had expected that the Satrap would be murdered and that evidence would point to the Old Traders. The swiftness of the reply indicated that those who responded had been awaiting the message.
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Она вновь подумала о птичьем послании, которое перехватил и принёс ей Роэд Кэрн. В нём обещали, что джамелийский флот вскоре выступит, чтобы отомстить продажным и мятежным Старым торговцам за убийство сатрапа. От одной мысли об этом Серилле становилось холодно. Послание пришло слишком быстро. Ни одна птица не могла лететь с такой скоростью. Для неё это означало, что заговор широко разветвлён и тянется до самой знати города Джамелии. Тот, кто послал птицу в Джамелию, ожидал, что сатрапа убьют и улики укажут на Старых торговцев. Быстрота ответа говорила о том, что те, кто ответил, ждали этого послания.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: The only question was how extensive the conspiracy was. Even if she could root out the source of it, she did not know if she could destroy it. If only Roed Caern and his men had not been so hasty the night that they seized the Satrap. If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them. They might have revealed who of the Jamaillian nobility were involved in this. But Restart was dead and the Vestrits missing. She’d get no answers there.

Если бы только Роэд Кэрн и его люди не проявили такой поспешности в ту ночь, когда захватили сатрапа. Если бы Давад Рестарт и Вестриты остались живы, из них, возможно, удалось бы вытянуть правду. Они могли бы выдать тех из джамелийской знати, кто был в это вовлечён. Но Рестарт был мёртв, а Вестриты пропали. Там ответов ей не получить.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: She pushed the chart to one side and replaced it with an elegant map of Bingtown. The finely-inked and illustrated work was one of the wonders she’d discovered in Restart’s library. In addition to the original grants of all the Old Traders, with each holding inked in the family’s colour, Davad had penned in the main claims of the New Traders. She studied it, wondering if it might offer some clue to his allies. She frowned over it, then lifted her pen, dipped it, and made a note to herself. She liked the location of Barberry Hill. It would be a convenient summer home for her, once all this strife was settled. It had been a New Trader holding; likely the Bingtown Traders would be glad to cede it to her. Or as the Satrap’s representative, she could simply take it.
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Она отодвинула карту в сторону и заменила её изящным планом Бингтауна. Эта тонко прорисованная и иллюстрированная работа была одним из чудес, обнаруженных ею в библиотеке Рестарта. Помимо первоначальных пожалований всех Старых торговцев, где каждое владение было обозначено цветом семьи, Давад нанёс главные притязания Новых торговцев. Она изучала его, гадая, не даст ли он какой-нибудь ключ к его союзникам. Она нахмурилась, разглядывая план, затем подняла перо, обмакнула его и сделала для себя пометку. Ей нравилось расположение Барбарисового холма. Когда вся эта распря уляжется, он станет для неё удобной летней резиденцией. Это было владение Нового торговца; вероятно, бингтаунские торговцы охотно уступят его ей. Или же, как представительница сатрапа, она могла просто забрать его.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: She considered again the bird-message Roed Caern had intercepted and brought to her.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: В нём обещали, что джамелийский флот вскоре выступит, чтобы отомстить продажным и мятежным Старым торговцам за убийство сатрапа.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Just to think of it made Serilla cold.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Just to think of it made Serilla cold.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: От одной мысли об этом Серилле становилось холодно.

mappedSourceRanges.text: Just to think of it made Serilla cold.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The message had arrived too soon.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The message had arrived too soon.

sourceRanges.text: The message had arrived too soon.

mappedSourceRanges.text: The message had arrived too soon.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: No bird could fly that fast.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: No bird could fly that fast.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Ни одна птица не могла лететь с такой скоростью.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: To her, it meant that the conspiracy was widespread, extending to the nobility of Jamaillia City itself.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Whoever had sent the bird to Jamaillia had expected that the Satrap would be murdered and that evidence would point to the Old Traders.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Whoever had sent the bird to Jamaillia had expected that the Satrap would be murdered and that evidence would point to the Old Traders.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Тот, кто послал птицу в Джамелию, ожидал, что сатрапа убьют и улики укажут на Старых торговцев.

sourceRanges.text: Whoever had sent the bird to Jamaillia had expected that the Satrap would be murdered and that evidence would point to the Old Traders.

targetRanges.text: Тот, кто послал птицу в Джамелию, ожидал, что сатрапа убьют и улики укажут на Старых торговцев.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The swiftness of the reply indicated that those who responded had been awaiting the message.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The swiftness of the reply indicated that those who responded had been awaiting the message.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Быстрота ответа говорила о том, что те, кто ответил, ждали этого послания.

mappedSourceRanges.text: The swiftness of the reply indicated that those who responded had been awaiting the message.

targetRanges.text: Быстрота ответа говорила о том, что те, кто ответил, ждали этого послания.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The only question was how extensive the conspiracy was.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The only question was how extensive the conspiracy was.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Единственный вопрос заключался в том, насколько разветвлён этот заговор.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: Even if she could root out the source of it, she did not know if she could destroy it.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: Even if she could root out the source of it, she did not know if she could destroy it.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Даже если ей удастся добраться до его истоков, она не знала, сумеет ли уничтожить его.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: If only Roed Caern and his men had not been so hasty the night that they seized the Satrap.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: If only Roed Caern and his men had not been so hasty the night that they seized the Satrap.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Если бы только Роэд Кэрн и его люди не проявили такой поспешности в ту ночь, когда захватили сатрапа.

mappedSourceRanges.text: If only Roed Caern and his men had not been so hasty the night that they seized the Satrap.

targetRanges.text: Если бы только Роэд Кэрн и его люди не проявили такой поспешности в ту ночь, когда захватили сатрапа.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Если бы Давад Рестарт и Вестриты остались живы, из них, возможно, удалось бы вытянуть правду.

sourceRanges.text: If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them.

mappedSourceRanges.text: If Davad Restart and the Vestrits had survived, the truth might have been wrung from them.

targetRanges.text: Если бы Давад Рестарт и Вестриты остались живы, из них, возможно, удалось бы вытянуть правду.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: They might have revealed who of the Jamaillian nobility were involved in this.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: They might have revealed who of the Jamaillian nobility were involved in this.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: But Restart was dead and the Vestrits missing.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: But Restart was dead and the Vestrits missing.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Но Рестарт был мёртв, а Вестриты пропали.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: She’d get no answers there.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: She’d get no answers there.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.targetText: Там ответов ей не получить.

sourceRanges.text: She’d get no answers there.

mappedSourceRanges.text: She’d get no answers there.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.sourceText: The finely-inked and illustrated work was one of the wonders she’d discovered in Restart’s library.
mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: The finely-inked and illustrated work was one of the wonders she’d discovered in Restart’s library.

mappedSentenceGroupAlignments.mappedSourceText: It would be a convenient summer home for her, once all this strife was settled.
